sardar-sarovar.conditions_add: The 1985 IDA credit and IBRD loan agreements carried 16 covenants on resettlement and rehabilitation, three on environment and three on health, including an obligation on the states to carry out a resettlement plan satisfactory to the Bank. In October 1992 the Bank's Board made continued support subject to India meeting environmental and resettlement performance benchmarks by 31 March 1993, including preparing full resettlement plans in each state; India asked to cancel the remaining US$181.5 million on 29 March 1993 (World Bank, Project Completion Report).

why.safeguard: obligation on the states to carry out a resettlement plan satisfactory to the Bank

kandadji-dam.conditions_add: The World Bank partly suspended the loan in 2016 for not complying with its policies, and to lift the suspension the government committed in 2017 to four measures, including agreeing with the Bank on the contents of long-term leases for farmers resettled on irrigated land (offered instead of full land titles). The government committed to wait for full completion of resettlement before filling the reservoir, and payments for the electro-mechanical works were made contingent on progress with resettlement in the reservoir area (RAP2A) (World Bank, Restructuring Paper, 2020).

why.safeguard: payments for the electro-mechanical works were made contingent on progress with resettlement
why.land: agreeing with the Bank on the contents of long-term leases for farmers resettled on irrigated land

toromocho-morococha.conditions_add: The US$2 billion China Eximbank loan (December 2010) was backed by a guarantee from the parent company Chinalco for the whole outstanding amount, and by all property, plant and equipment of the Toromocho project as collateral if Chinalco's financial standing worsened. Chinalco also had to pay a 1% commission on each drawdown; the loan carried interest of six-month LIBOR plus 1.85% over 15 years (AidData record 36064).

why.repay: backed by a guarantee from the parent company Chinalco for the whole outstanding amount

why.safeguard: required the fund to make sure the projects it backed, including Santa Rita, were run according to IFC Performance Standards
